faq.q: Is the NoseFrida suitable for newborns?
faq.a: Yes, suitable from birth. The tube sits against the outside of the nostril, never inside, and the parent controls the suction. Use saline drops first and suction gently. If a newborn has persistent congestion, difficulty breathing or a fever, see a GP or child health nurse.

faq.q: Will I get mucus in my mouth?
faq.a: No. A disposable hygiene filter sits between the collection chamber and the mouthpiece and is designed to stop mucus travelling toward the mouth. Replace the filter after every use.

1. Insert a fresh filter. 2. Saline drops in each nostril, wait 20 to 30 seconds. 3. Rest the blue tube against the outside of the nostril to make a seal. 4. Breathe in gently through the red mouthpiece with a small circular motion. 5. Repeat on the other side. 6. Disassemble, bin the filter, wash the parts (top rack dishwasher safe; clear tube with 70% isopropyl alcohol). Full guide: /blogs/baby-care-guides/how-to-use-the-nosefrida-the-complete-australian-guide

faq.q: How often can I use it?
faq.a: As often as needed, typically before feeds and before sleep during a cold. It is non-invasive and parent-controlled. Congestion lasting more than ten days, or with fever or breathing difficulty, needs a GP.

faq.q: How often do I replace filters?
faq.a: After every use. Filters are single-use for hygiene and suction. Replacement packs of 20: /products/frida-baby-nosefrida-filters

faq.q: My baby cries when I use it. Am I doing it wrong?
faq.a: Almost certainly not. Crying is normal, it is an unusual sensation rather than a painful one. A second person holding baby's arms helps. It stops as soon as you finish.

A dummy-shaped medicine dispenser. Measure the dose into the syringe, attach it to the dummy, and press slowly as baby sucks so the liquid goes to the side of the cheek. Follow the dose your pharmacist or doctor gives. /products/frida-baby-medifrida

faq.q: What is the Flake Fixer for?
faq.a: Cradle cap. Three steps in the bath: lather with the sponge, loosen with the silicone brush, lift flakes with the fine-tooth comb. A couple of times a week. If the scalp is red, weeping or not improving, see a GP or child health nurse.

faq.q: What is in the SnipperClipper Set?
faq.a: Baby nail clippers with a safety guard and built-in magnifier, plus a nail file, for very small fingers and toes.

faq.q: When do I start dental care?
faq.a: The Fingerbrush is for gums and first teeth from birth. The ToothHugger is a triple-sided toothbrush for toddlers. Australian dental guidance is to start brushing when the first tooth appears.

Packing a hospital bag and want everything in one order: the Labour & Delivery Kit (includes gown, socks, carry bag and peri bottle). Already have a gown and want recovery items for home: the Postpartum Recovery Kit (no peri bottle or gown). Buying both together gets 10% off the Recovery Kit in cart.

faq.q: Are the kits suitable after a caesarean?
faq.a: Yes. Lochia (postpartum bleeding) happens after every birth, so the peri bottle, ice pads, liners and underwear are all still relevant. For an incision, add the High Waist Disposable Underwear, which sits above the scar (/products/frida-mom-disposable-high-waist-underwear). Guide: /blogs/postpartum-guides/c-section-recovery-in-australia-what-to-expect-in-the-first-six-weeks

faq.q: How do the ice pads work?
faq.a: Bend to activate, no freezer needed. Cooling comfort for the first 72 hours, and they are a full absorbent maternity pad as well. /products/frida-mom-instant-ice-maxi-pads

faq.q: How do I use the foam and liners?
faq.a: Place a witch hazel cooling liner along your maternity pad, add one pump of Perineal Foam on top, replace with every pad change. Cooling comfort for perineal swelling and postpartum haemorrhoids.

Rinsing with warm water after every toilet visit instead of wiping in the first weeks. The upside-down angled nozzle reaches without contortion. Useful after vaginal and caesarean births. /products/frida-mom-peri-bottle
Boyshort suits vaginal birth recovery. High waist sits above a caesarean incision. Both are soft, stretchy and disposable, and hold pads in place.

faq.q: Where can I buy Frida in store?
faq.a: Baby Bunting stocks Frida Baby and Frida Mom in around 75 stores nationally, plus independents such as Bubs n Grubs, Baby Kingdom, Baby Village, Kiddie Country, Babyroad and HoneyBaby. Full list by state: /pages/stockists

faq.q: Can midwives or clinics get samples?
faq.a: Yes. Health professionals can request a NoseFrida clinic sample and printed handouts through the form at /pages/health-professionals. Printable A5 patient handouts for every product are at /pages/patient-handouts.
